item.text: The inline formset currently clears any referenced field that has a default when the parent is new. That treats a unique UUID foreign-key target like an auto-generated primary key, so the parent’s UUID default is erased. I’m checking the existing inline tests to add a regression case that matches this model setup.

Fixed the inline formset behavior: it now clears a default only when the referenced field is the parent’s primary key. Added an admin regression test for a child inline targeting a UUID field.
